name: Proposer Crash After Partial Accepts
description: P1 reaches Phase 2 with ACCEPTs queued to A1 and A2. The ACCEPT to A2 is dropped, then A1 receives and accepts. P1 crashes before the ACCEPTED response is delivered. P2 enters with a higher round and discovers A1's evidence — P2 is forced to adopt "A" even though only one acceptor knew.
